implemented: Rebuilt the Maison Passage homepage around a new Grand Tour Ledger direction instead of the previous frosted-card editorial shell.
Replaced the old hero with a dark cover spread, specimen route folio, and quieter premium copy that frames the product as a route dossier.
Replaced the previous planner panel with a planner atelier made of numbered brief sheets, a sticky brief ribbon, a compare bar, and more intentional control groupings.
Rebuilt the results area into a result folio with an opening dock, left and right ticket cards for outbound and return, and a central open-jaw gap band.
Reworked lower-page storytelling into a proof strip, method rail, trip archetypes, concierge CTA, and a darker footer so the whole page reads as one visual system.
Updated global typography and color treatment with a sharper display/body pairing and a parchment, walnut, and brass material system.

Preserved the existing overseas open-jaw planning logic, flexible month comparison, stay-window behavior, estimate transparency, and Skyscanner handoff flow while changing the presentation substantially.
known_issues: Displayed fares are still deterministic reference estimates and are not live API-backed inventory.
Headless screenshot review was used as a visual gut-check, but full interactive browser automation is still unavailable in this session.
